newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest BUX index flat despite Euro trends.
newsitem.headline: Budapest BUX index flat despite Euro trends.

text.p: Hungarian shares traded mixed on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Monday and the market as a whole was unable to make advantage from rises on most major bourses, traders said.
The BUX index ended at 3,531.71 points, down 1.38.
"The market as a whole was stagnant...there don't seem to be too many buyers," said Peter Lencs of MKB Securities. "This is strange as the picture was positive on almost all major bourses," he said.
Pharmaceuticals shares led the market's decline, but hotelier Danubius and packaging firm Cofinec were also among the losers.

On the gaining side, the market's illiquid papers led the rises, including frozen food maker Goldsun which gained 25 percent to end at 250 forints, still remaining well below the 1,000-forint face value.
The market seems to have run out of steam and Lencs said he expected mostly stagnant market for the coming period.
"I don't expect prices to plunge because hardly any shares are held by trembling-handed investors. Today's pattern is more likely to continue," Lencs said.
BUX index futures firmed for five maturities by 14.50 to 55.00 points and remained unchanged for the longest, 1998 June, maturity.
